notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes:
I want to share some updates on the game’s development. I’ve been focusing on improving the game’s foundation so I can deliver smoother updates and more exciting features in the future. Here’s what’s new:

Codebase Improvements – The game’s code has been restructured to allow for a more flexible development process, making it easier to introduce new features.

Save System Overhaul – I’ve completely reworked the save system to make it more reliable and future-proof.

Preparing for Upcoming Features

The game now supports adding new product types in future updates.

Initial groundwork has been laid for a shop system, where players will eventually be able to purchase different types of stock.

This update focuses on behind-the-scenes improvements to make future updates faster and more seamless. Thank you all for your patience and support.
